products.name: Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Rules & MITRE ATT&CK Detection Coverage — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn raw logs into real detections — analytics rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK with tuned thresholds and low false positives.
products.description:
Turn raw logs into real detections — analytics rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK with tuned thresholds and low false positives.

A SIEM with no tuned detections is just an expensive log bucket. This solution enables and tunes Sentinel analytics rules, maps your coverage to the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, closes the highest-risk gaps, and reduces false positives so your team trusts the alerts.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Rule enablement — scheduled, NRT, and Microsoft-provided rule templates
  • MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping and gap analysis
  • Threshold & entity tuning to cut false positives
  • Watchlists and enrichment for context
  • Detection-as-code export for versioning and reuse

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A tuned, ATT&CK-mapped detection set your SOC can trust — fewer false positives, fewer blind spots.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SENTRULE-Coverage.ps1 — build the MITRE ATT&CK coverage matrix and gap list from enabled rules (read-only)
    • SENTRULE-Discovery.ps1 — inventory enabled analytics rules, available templates, watchlists and detection-table freshness (read-only)
    • SENTRULE-Export.ps1 — export enabled analytics rules to files for detection-as-code (export-only)
    • SENTRULE-Report.ps1 — per-rule alert volume and false-positive (benign) rate for tuning (read-only)
    • SENTRULE-Validate.ps1 — check the detection set against the 05-testing.md pass/fail gates (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
